description: This file implements a rate-limited, priority queue system for node lifecycle management in Kubernetes scheduler, including data structures for timed values, queues, and rate limiting logic.

classes.name: TimedValue
classes.description: Represents a value to be processed at a specific time, with an identifier and timestamps.

classes.name: TimedQueue
classes.description: A priority heap of TimedValues ordered by their ProcessAt time.

classes.name: UniqueQueue
classes.description: A FIFO queue that guarantees each element is added only once until removed, with thread-safe operations.

classes.name: RateLimitedTimedQueue
classes.description: A rate-limited, priority queue managing TimedValues with concurrency control and external rate limiting.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the length of the TimedQueue.

methods.name: Less
methods.description: Determines if the ProcessAt time of one TimedValue is before another.

methods.name: Swap
methods.description: Swaps two elements in the TimedQueue.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes a new TimedValue onto the TimedQueue.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the TimedValue with the earliest ProcessAt.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a TimedValue to the UniqueQueue if not already present.

methods.name: Replace
methods.description: Replaces an existing TimedValue in the queue with a new one if it exists.

methods.name: RemoveFromQueue
methods.description: Removes a TimedValue from the queue but keeps it in the set.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the queue and set, allowing re-addition later.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the oldest TimedValue from the queue.

methods.name: Head
methods.description: Returns the oldest TimedValue without removing it.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the queue and set.

methods.name: Try
methods.description: Processes items in the RateLimitedTimedQueue respecting rate limits and process times.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new TimedValue to the rate-limited queue.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the rate-limited queue.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the rate-limited queue.

methods.name: SwapLimiter
methods.description: Replaces the current rate limiter with a new one if QPS differs.
